title: Offline drafts for Field Notes
why: Losing signal on a trail loses the note you were writing.

change.before: Field Notes needs a connection to save. Drop signal mid-sentence and the draft is gone.
change.after: Notes save on the device first, sync when signal returns, and flag conflicts instead of overwriting.

acceptance.criterion: Drafts persist across a restart with no network
Queued edits sync in order when signal returns
A conflicting edit shows a banner instead of overwriting
The offline indicator reflects real connectivity
Writing in airplane mode feels calm

check.judgment: In airplane mode, write a note, reconnect, and confirm nothing was lost.

units.title: Local draft store
units.goal: Persist drafts on the device before any network call.

units.title: Sync queue
units.goal: Replay queued edits in order when connectivity returns.

units.title: Conflict banner
units.goal: Surface conflicting edits rather than overwriting.
